category: market data API (US and Chinese stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, end-of-day prices, IEX, crypto, forex, news)

free_tier.stated: Starter plan USD 0/month: 50 requests per hour, 1000 requests per day, 500 unique symbols per month and 1 GB of bandwidth per month; 30+ years of end-of-day price history
free_tier.notes: Hourly requests reset every hour, daily requests at midnight EST, and monthly bandwidth on the first of the month at midnight EST; there is no per-minute or per-second limit. The News API reaches 3 months of history. The Power plan is USD 30/month (or USD 300/year) for individuals with 10,000 requests per hour, 100,000 per day and 40 GB per month.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated per call; 1 GB of bandwidth per month bounds the Starter plan

retention.stated: not applicable: a query API with no stored objects

egress.terms: 1 GB of API bandwidth per month on Starter, 40 GB on Power

interface_detail: GET https://api.tiingo.com/tiingo/daily/<ticker>/prices with the token as ?token= or an Authorization: Token header; JSON or CSV via format=; the documentation also describes a WebSocket API. A call with no token answered HTTP 403.
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; supported_tickers.zip lists every ticker and is updated daily
chaining: Deep end-of-day history (30+ years) at 1000 calls a day for up to 500 symbols a month; it pairs with FRED for macro series. Marketstack's US end-of-day prices are licensed from Tiingo.

limits.value: 1000 requests per day on Starter, reset at midnight EST
1 GB of bandwidth per month on Starter, reset on the first of the month

limits_note: 500 unique symbols per month on Starter (no limits kind counts symbols). Bulk path: no bulk path for prices; supported_tickers.zip (805453 bytes, keyless) is a daily ticker list, not prices.
binding_note: Pulled steadily, the 1000 per day count binds before the 50 per hour; a burst meets the hourly 50 first.

identity_cost.detail: Every API call needs a token from an account. The registration form asks for a username, an email, a password entered twice and a terms checkbox, behind a Cloudflare Turnstile check; it has no card field. Card or PayPal is asked only when signing up for a paid plan.

confidence_note: The Starter quotas, reset times, storage rule and registration fields are documented on the pricing, documentation and terms pages and in the site's own script bundle. Probes measured that a call with no token answers HTTP 403 and that supported_tickers.zip is served with no key. The quota cut-offs need a token to measure.
